Marie (Support): hi @ACME-Infra 1 saw your ticket about credits dropping to 0 ~1h before expected refill. Can you paste the org id and quick repro?
ACME-Infra: org_98765. Noticed this on 2023-12-13 around 23:50 CET. Dashboard showed 0 tokens, then at 00:00 CET they refilled. Is reset midnight local or UTC?
Marie (Support): our monthly refill runs at 00:00 UTC for most tenants. Account timezone is display-only; refill anchors to UTC. Can you share the API request ids / response headers? Need to confirm X-Quota-Reset.
ACME-Infra: pasted two calls from our service logs 1 one succeeded then a 429 a few seconds later:
```
2023-12-13T23:59:50+01:00 POST /v1/complete 200 req_id=rs:abcd
2023-12-13T23:59:55+01:00 POST /v1/complete 429 req_id=rs:abce headers: X-Quota-Remaining: 0
```
Raj (SRE): thanks. Any raw 429 response headers? look for X-Quota-Reset or X-Reset-UTC.
ACME-Infra: here's a 429 response we captured:
```
X-Quota-Limit: 1000000
X-Quota-Remaining: 0
X-Quota-Reset: 1705123200
```
Jenna (Billing): quick calc 1 epoch 1705123200 is 2023-12-13 23:00 UTC. That's off by -1h relative to the expected next-month boundary. Weird.
Marie (Support): following up to eng 1 @Raj any known DST/timezone issues in display/cache layer?
Raj (SRE): short answer: yes maybe. Infra runs the canonical refill at 00:00 UTC, but the display cache worker (tenant_quota_display) writes a tenant-local visible balance for dashboards. If that worker applies Europe/Paris offset incorrectly during DST boundaries it can show 0 early until the canonical job finishes. I'll escalate to eng-runtime.
Raj (SRE): repro notes for eng-runtime:
1) set tenant timezone = Europe/Paris
2) consume tokens to 0 just before UTC month boundary
3) monitor /v1/usage API and dashboard cache (tenant_quota_display) for 1-3m window
4) grep "populate-display-cache" in worker logs
Marie (Support): proposed customer fix: apply a one-off credit for org_98765 to cover the missed window and mark for audit. @Jenna can finance do that?
Jenna (Billing): yes we can apply a manual credit and pro-rate if needed. I'll open a billing ticket and tag finance. Send the exact UTC window to cover.
ACME-Infra: we lost ~10 requests during the window 1 impacted a short job. Thanks for the manual credit.
Raj (SRE): created internal issue INF-4123 assigned to eng-runtime. Short-term guidance: schedule critical monthly jobs after 00:05 UTC or add client retry/backoff to tolerate transient 429s.
Marie (Support): will schedule the credit and follow up when eng posts a patch. :thumbsup: 
quota-bot: incident INF-4123 created by Raj; priority P2; assignee: eng-runtime
ACME-Infra: thanks all 1 we'll shift our nightly run to 00:10 UTC for now.
